title: Lesson 1 Quiz: The Power of Consistency and Compound Growth

questions.text: According to the narration, after twenty years of contributing TT$300 per month, what proportion of the final balance TT$135,000 is attributable to compound growth?
questions.explanation: The narration states that over twenty years, more than forty percent of the total balance came from compound growth, not from the contributions.

questions.text: True or false: You must have a massive salary to start benefiting from compound growth in Trinidad and Tobago.
questions.explanation: The narration explicitly says you do not need a massive salary to start the process of building wealth through consistency and compound growth.
